title: Heat Check, Week 7
dek: Kendre Miller took 20 carries and the most snaps in New Orleans. The stove's on in the Saints' backfield.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Thu 5:05 PM ET: Chig Okonkwo ran a route on more than 80 percent of the dropbacks at SF and Rachaad White played about 70 percent of the snaps, so both stay risers to stash through the bye.

Updated Thu 4:55 PM ET: the rest-of-season ranks are refreshed. Matthew Golden is WR25 and Luther Burden III WR22, both still risers to trade for; MarShawn Lloyd falls to RB55 and stays a drop, and Tyler Allgeier is RB44 and still a drop for Bam Knight.

Updated Thu 4:35 PM ET: Jeremiyah Love did not practice Wednesday and is expected to miss Week 7, so Bam Knight stays an add at 1 to 3 percent and Tyler Allgeier stays a drop. Josh Jacobs practiced Thursday, and MarShawn Lloyd is still a drop.

Updated Thu 4:20 PM ET: added Chig Okonkwo and Rachaad White as risers and Jacory Croskey-Merritt as a faller after his IR move.

Updated Tue 6:15 PM ET: Terry McLaurin tore his patellar tendon and is out for the season, per Dan Quinn; drop him for any add.

Heat Check is about direction, not box scores. A riser earned more of the ball week over week or got a new role you can see in the snap counts; a faller is losing snaps, routes or targets. One number backs each call, ranks are rest of season for me, and the scoring is PPR. Week 7 lineup ranks come with Wednesday's Menu.
outro_md: Butcher Shop turns these trends into trade offers, and the Menu ranks every one of them for Week 7 on Wednesday.

risers.stat: 20 carries on 32 snaps, the most of any Saints back
risers.why: Kendre Miller (NO) ran 20 times for 70 in the 34-27 win at NYG, while Alvin Kamara played 19 snaps and sat the fourth quarter with the back. Travis Etienne Jr. is on IR until after Week 8.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Germie Bernard (PIT) caught 11 of 12 targets for 87 and the overtime TD at TB, a week after a team-high 9 targets vs IND. Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. are on IR.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: 82% of the snaps in his first game off IR
risers.why: Omar Cooper Jr. (NYJ) played 51 snaps at NE and caught 6 of 7 for 103 and a 48-yard TD. Adonai Mitchell is week to week after the finger procedure.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 6 to 12 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Keenan Allen (IND) caught 8 for 82 on a team-high 11 targets vs TEN with Tyler Warren out. Josh Downs caught 4 for 40 on 8.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Target share 36% to 37%; 16 targets in Week 6
risers.why: Emeka Egbuka (TB) drew 25 targets over two weeks with Jalon Daniels at quarterback, 7 for 48 and a TD vs PIT. The volume stays, and Baker Mayfield's return fixes the efficiency.
risers.verdict: WR27 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

risers.stat: 86% of the snaps, 13 targets in Week 6
risers.why: Matthew Golden (GB) led Green Bay with 13 targets vs DAL and caught 6 for 104 and a TD. Christian Watson caught 3 of 8.
risers.verdict: WR25 rest of season for me, and the targets say higher. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

risers.stat: 28 carries; no other Carolina back over 1
risers.why: Chuba Hubbard (CAR) ran 28 times for 120 and a TD at PHI, including a 19-yard run on fourth-and-1.
risers.verdict: RB21 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

risers.stat: 6 then 7 targets; 3 TDs in two weeks
risers.why: Kyle Pitts Sr. (ATL) caught 5 for 60 and 2 TDs vs CHI on 21 percent of the targets, after 5 of 6 for 42 and a TD in Week 5. His share has climbed every week, so the touchdowns sit on real volume. A week under 15 percent of the targets is what would change the call.
risers.verdict: TE14 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell him for a backup tight end.

risers.stat: Led Chicago in receiving yards two straight weeks
risers.why: Luther Burden III (CHI) caught all 8 of his targets for 95 at ATL with Caleb Williams back. He ran 17 or 18 routes, 42 to 44 percent of the dropbacks, so the role is still growing.
risers.verdict: WR22 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR4 and a bench RB.
risers.price: a WR4 and a bench RB

risers.stat: Snap share up to a season-high 35%
risers.why: Mike Washington Jr. (LV) took half of the early-down snaps vs BUF and turned 10 touches into 50 yards. Ashton Jeanty still out-touched him 14 to 10.
risers.verdict: RB48 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Targets 5, then 8; 11 catches and 3 TDs in two weeks
risers.why: DeMario Douglas (NE) caught 7 of 8 for 86 and a TD vs NYJ, after 4 for 65 and 2 TDs vs LV. Romeo Doubs is on IR, and New England plays at CHI Thursday.
risers.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB, before Thursday night.

risers.stat: 15 carries for 80 on 44% of the snaps
risers.why: Bam Knight (ARI) out-ran Tyler Allgeier at LAR, 15 for 80 to 18 for 38, and got most of the red-zone touches with Jeremiyah Love out. Love did not practice Wednesday and is expected to miss Week 7 vs DEN.
risers.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Route rate 50%, ahead of Darren Waller for the first time
risers.why: Tommy Tremble (CAR) played 68 percent of the snaps at PHI and caught all 4 targets for 46 and 2 TDs. Darren Waller ran a route on 45 percent of the dropbacks and caught none.
risers.verdict: Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB, in deep leagues.

risers.stat: 9 routes on 12 snaps in his Houston debut
risers.why: Marvin Harrison Jr. (HOU) caught 3 of 4 for 34 at JAX in a part-time debut DeMeco Ryans planned. His route share vs NYG is the next step, and a second game under half the routes is what would change the call.
risers.verdict: WR37 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell after a 12-snap game.

risers.why: Corey Kiner (NE) out-gained Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ, 57 yards to 36 on 3 fewer carries, and took the late work after TreVeyon Henderson's fumble.
risers.verdict: Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB, in deep leagues.

risers.stat: 13 targets over Weeks 5 and 6, 7 of 7 for 69 at SF
risers.why: Chig Okonkwo (WAS) ran a route on more than 80 percent of the dropbacks and caught all 7 of his targets for 69 yards in the 23-17 loss at SF, a week after a team-high 6 targets. Terry McLaurin is out for the season, and Washington is on bye in Week 7. TE19 rest of season for me.
risers.verdict: Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: 11 touches and a TD at SF, 5 targets
risers.why: Rachaad White (WAS) played about 70 percent of the snaps at SF and led Washington's backs with 7 carries for 27 and 4 catches on 5 targets for 30 and a TD. Jacory Croskey-Merritt went on IR with the groin Monday and misses at least four games. RB38 rest of season for me.
risers.verdict: Stash him through the bye, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

fallers.why: Cam Skattebo (NYG) played 6 snaps vs NO after his fourth lost fumble, while Devin Singletary played 40 percent and Tyrone Tracy Jr. 38. John Harbaugh denied a benching and said someone needs to step up.
fallers.verdict: A second game under 15 snaps makes him a drop. Monitor; the Giants' Wednesday practice report and the Week 7 depth chart.
fallers.watch: the Giants' Wednesday practice report and the Week 7 depth chart

fallers.stat: Snaps 12, then 19; sat the fourth quarter
fallers.why: Alvin Kamara (NO) ran 7 times for 34 at NYG while Kendre Miller ran 20 times. Kamara's back has cost him snaps two weeks running.
fallers.verdict: RB41 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
fallers.price: a bench WR with a weekly role

fallers.stat: Snap share 76% in Weeks 1 to 4, then 53% and 58%
fallers.why: Ashton Jeanty (LV) ran 10 times for 22 vs BUF while Mike Washington Jr. took half of the early downs. His usage fell, but his price fell further, which is why Butcher Shop has him as a buy. Washington passing him in snaps is what would change the call.
fallers.verdict: RB11 rest of season for me. Hold him.

fallers.stat: 18 carries for 38 to Bam Knight's 15 for 80
fallers.why: Tyler Allgeier (ARI) played 40 snaps at LAR and lost the red-zone work to Knight with Jeremiyah Love out. Love did not practice Wednesday and is expected to miss Week 7, and Knight is the back to own.
fallers.verdict: RB44 rest of season for me. Drop him for Knight or any add on the list.

fallers.why: MarShawn Lloyd (GB) played 30 snaps to Pierre Strong Jr.'s 41 vs DAL and ran 8 times for 10. Josh Jacobs is off the exempt list and eligible, though Matt LaFleur would not commit to him playing at DET; Jacobs practiced Thursday in his first week back.
fallers.verdict: RB55 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.stat: Over half the snaps in Week 5, then 1 carry and 1 catch
fallers.why: Tyjae Spears (TEN) touched the ball twice at IND while Tony Pollard ran a season-high 19 times for 76.
fallers.verdict: RB47 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.why: Darren Waller (CAR) caught 0 of 2 targets on 36 snaps at PHI, and Tommy Tremble ran more routes than him for the first time.
fallers.verdict: TE33 rest of season for me. Drop him for Tremble or any tight end on the list.

fallers.why: Josh Downs (IND) drew 8 targets vs TEN while Keenan Allen drew 11, the third straight week Allen has had 9 or more.
fallers.verdict: WR35 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench RB.

fallers.stat: Snap share 71% in Week 5, then 14 carries for 36
fallers.why: Rhamondre Stevenson (NE) still led the backs with 41 snaps vs NYJ, but Corey Kiner ran 11 times for 57 and TreVeyon Henderson is back.
fallers.verdict: RB24 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
fallers.price: a bench WR with a full-time role

fallers.why: Rome Odunze (CHI) caught 3 of 4 for 39 at ATL while Luther Burden III and Colston Loveland drew 15 targets between them.
fallers.verdict: WR32 rest of season for me. Monitor; his targets vs NE Thursday night.
fallers.watch: his targets vs NE Thursday night

fallers.stat: 22 of 24 back carries, then 44% of the rushes
fallers.why: Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) ran 12 times for 39 vs HOU while Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 11 for 55, and two receiving TDs covered it. Jacksonville is on bye in Week 7. Back over 60 percent of the rushes in Week 8 makes him a buy again; another near-even split makes him a sell.
fallers.verdict: RB18 rest of season for me. Hold him through the bye.

fallers.stat: Benched for the second half; 0 catches two straight games
fallers.why: Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) played 15 snaps vs HOU, and Travis Hunter and Josh Cameron took his snaps.
fallers.verdict: WR49 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench receiver.

fallers.why: Omarion Hampton (LAC) ran 7 times for 18 at KC in a three-way split, though he led the backs in routes. The Chargers are 0-6 and the play-caller is in question during the bye.
fallers.verdict: RB19 rest of season for me. Monitor; the Chargers' play-caller decision before Week 8.
fallers.watch: the Chargers' play-caller decision before Week 8

fallers.why: Mike Evans (SF) left Monday night vs WAS with the Achilles and came back, and Kyle Shanahan called it tendinitis. San Francisco is bracing for him to miss at ATL, with the bye in Week 8.
fallers.verdict: WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

fallers.stat: Torn patellar tendon, out for the season
fallers.why: Terry McLaurin (WAS) tore the patellar tendon in his left knee on a non-contact route at SF Monday night, and Dan Quinn said Tuesday he needs surgery and misses the rest of the season. He finishes with 230 yards and one TD.
fallers.verdict: Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.stat: On IR, out at least four games
fallers.why: Washington placed Jacory Croskey-Merritt (WAS) on IR with the groin Monday, so he is out at least four games, about Weeks 8 to 11 after the bye. Rachaad White took the backfield at SF. RB43 rest of season for me.
fallers.verdict: Hold him in an IR spot; with no IR spot open, drop him for any add on the list.
